signals: Session 63 left Solara deployable with 54 tests passing, but the generated public backend surfaces still say SUPABASE_DB_URL while project decisions now require PG_CONNECTION_SOLARA for cloud project fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp.

The Daily Rite now consumes Director route segments, but room consequences are still mostly narration; the next high-leverage move is to make each segment produce deterministic player-facing risk/reward and next-action receipts.

The public-safe feedback ledger counts starts, ends, shares, and repairs, but it does not yet convert those signals into a zero-token recommendation loop for the menu, status JSON, and Studio integrations.
App.jsx is still 4,229 lines; extracting one more Daily Rite seam is the safest way to reduce risk without destabilizing canvas, combat, inventory, or save flows.

items.title: PG Connection Truth Gate - align workflow, contracts, and public JSON to PG_CONNECTION_SOLARA
items.why: Solara's live decision record says the hardening credential is project-scoped PG_CONNECTION_SOLARA, but code, workflow preflight, tests, and generated public JSON still mention SUPABASE_DB_URL. This is a process-honesty and founder-pressure bug: the public contract should point at the credential that is actually safe for this project.
items.recipe: Update backend readiness and contract modules, the Supabase Hardening workflow, tests, generated public status/chronicle output, and task-board language so the hardening gate consistently names PG_CONNECTION_SOLARA while preserving the owner SQL-editor fallback.

items.title: Rite Consequence Engine - turn Director room segments into deterministic risk/reward receipts
items.why: Director-aware rooms currently tell the player what segment they entered, but they do not yet produce a compact consequence model that later rewards, debriefs, and telemetry can share. A deterministic consequence engine makes the Daily Rite feel authored by the sun instead of merely described by it.
items.recipe: Add a Daily Rite consequence module that derives entry, clear, failure, reward, urgency, and next-action copy from the current segment; wire it into run start, room transition, death/clear share-card myth lines, and tests.

items.title: Feedback Next-Action Digest - convert local aggregate events into a zero-token recommendation loop
items.why: The local feedback ledger is privacy-safe but passive. Solara should use those capped aggregate events to tell the player and Studio integrations what the runtime most needs next: first run, completed run, share, import recovery, or backend activation.
items.recipe: Extend feedbackLedger with a digest that names the strongest missing/underused action, expose it in public chronicle/status integrations, render it on the front door, and test that it stays sanitized and zero-token.

items.title: Daily Run Session Extraction - pull Daily Rite run object assembly out of App.jsx
items.why: Full canvas/combat decomposition is still too risky for a single unattended pass, but the Daily Rite run object now has enough stable inputs to leave App.jsx. A small factory reduces main-component responsibility and creates a repeatable pattern for the next extraction tranche.
items.recipe: Add a dailyRunSession module that creates and completes Daily Rite session state from room weave, mechanics, vow, challenge, and consequence inputs; use it from App.jsx and cover it with Node tests.

skipped.reason: Still requires the project-scoped PG_CONNECTION_SOLARA database credential or owner SQL-editor access.
Still conflicts with Solara's deterministic-first, zero-browser-token, free-tier cost-neutral posture.
Correct next technical mountain, but too high-risk before another guarded Daily Rite extraction lands.

executionLog.evidence: Backend readiness, backend contract summary, Supabase Hardening workflow, tests, docs, public/status.json, and public/chronicle.json now use PG_CONNECTION_SOLARA. Active source/tests/workflow/public output contain no SUPABASE_DB_URL references.

src/game/dailyRiteConsequences.js derives deterministic entry, clear, failure, share, urgency, reward, and next-action copy from Director route segments; src/App.jsx uses those consequences in the Daily Rite runtime.
src/game/feedbackLedger.js emits a zero-token next_action digest, src/App.jsx renders it on the front door, and public chronicle/status exports include it in feedback_summary.

src/game/dailyRunSession.js creates and completes Daily Rite run state, including room weave, pacing coach, consequence, and share-card creation. tests/june10-systems.test.mjs covers the factory and completion behavior.
